desc: Save the frozen blueprints to a TOML file
r: composer-cli-blueprints-freeze-save - Save the frozen blueprints to a TOML file
Save the complete blueprints with their depsolved packages and modules in TOML formatted files named BLUEPRINT-NAME.frozen.toml

--filename
="" Optional path and filename to save blueprint into
-h, --help
[=false] help for save

-a, --api
=1 Server API Version to use
-j, --json
[=false] Output the raw JSON response instead of the normal output
--log
="" Path to optional logfile
-s, --socket
="/run/weldr/api.socket" Path to the server's socket file
--test
=0 Pass test mode to compose. 1=Mock compose with fail. 2=Mock compose with finished.
--timeout
=240 Timeout to use for server communication. Set to 0 for no timeout

composer-cli blueprints freeze save tmux-image


  composer-cli blueprints freeze save tmux-image --filename /var/tmp/


  composer-cli blueprints freeze save tmux-image --filename /var/tmp/new-tmux-image.toml
